questions.question: What shape of the billet is used in the Transverse wedge Rolling Process:

explanations.a: Square billets are not typically used.
explanations.b: Round billets are used in transverse wedge rolling.

questions.question: The following is not the version of Transverse Wedge Rolling:

explanations.a: Three-roll systems are used in TWR.
explanations.b: Planetary rolls are a version of TWR.
explanations.c: Punch and die is not a TWR method.

questions.question: What type of profile is used on rolls in this TWR process:

explanations.a: Wedge-shaped profiles are used in TWR.
